items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: He came up and he liked the tune, he gave us $500 advance.

ctx.x: He came up and he liked the tune, he gave us $500 advance. He just heard the tune at Fry's. Yeah. So he says, you don't mind if I do anything with it? He's never been to New Orleans. So he says, we're going to change the title to the, that was a place called the Suburban Gardens. We used to call it the Tin Roof Cafe.
